name: thesis-writer
description: Co-drafting for doctoral theses in LaTeX, with Zotero research and citations.

interface.shortDescription: Co-drafting for doctoral theses in LaTeX, with Zotero research and citations.
interface.longDescription: A dual-vendor thesis writing plugin: the author writes, and agents propose structure, review for accuracy, check facts against Zotero, sweep prose against the report guidelines, generate figures, format, review, and log authorship.
defaultPrompt: Help me plan and draft a thesis chapter.
Sweep a thesis section for weasel words and report-guideline issues.
